mapper.sql: id, entry_id, task_id, node_key, node_type, status, operator_id, prev_status, skip_by, skip_time, abandon_by, abandon_time, claim_time, done_time, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM label_entry_node WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM label_entry_node WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id IN
#{entryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO label_entry_node ( entry_id, task_id, node_key, node_type, status, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{entryId}, #{taskId}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeType}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )

INSERT IGNORE INTO label_entry_node ( entry_id, task_id, node_key, node_type, operator_id, status, claim_time, done_time, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time, deleted ) SELECT e.id, e.task_id, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeType}, CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN e.reviewer_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN 'claimed' WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN 'done' ELSE 'pending' END, CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN e.update_time ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN e.review_time ELSE NULL END, #{userId}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM label_data_entry e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND e.task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_data_entry e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND e.task_id = #{taskId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM label_entry_node n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.entry_id = e.id AND n.node_key = #{nodeKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'claimed', operator_id = #{operatorId}, claim_time = NOW(), prev_status = NULL, skip_by = NULL, skip_time = NULL, abandon_by = NULL, abandon_time = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND status IN ('pending', 'skipped', 'abandoned')

UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'skipped', prev_status = #{prevStatus}, skip_by = #{skipBy}, skip_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND status IN ('pending', 'claimed')

UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'abandoned', prev_status = #{prevStatus}, abandon_by = #{abandonBy}, abandon_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND status IN ('pending', 'claimed')

UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = #{restoredStatus}, prev_status = NULL, skip_by = NULL, skip_time = NULL, abandon_by = NULL, abandon_time = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND status IN ('skipped', 'abandoned')
UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'done', done_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND status = 'claimed'

UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'pending', operator_id = NULL, prev_status = NULL, skip_by = NULL, skip_time = NULL, abandon_by = NULL, abandon_time = NULL, claim_time = NULL, done_time = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND status = 'claimed'

UPDATE label_entry_node SET status = 'done', done_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_id = #{taskId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND status IN ('pending', 'claimed')

UPDATE label_entry_node n JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = n.entry_id SET n.status = CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN 'claimed' WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN 'done' ELSE 'pending' END, n.operator_id = CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN e.reviewer_id WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN n.operator_id ELSE NULL END, n.claim_time = CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('reviewing', 're_reviewing') THEN n.claim_time ELSE NULL END, n.done_time = CASE WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN e.review_time ELSE NULL END, n.prev_status = NULL, n.skip_by = NULL, n.skip_time = NULL, n.abandon_by = NULL, n.abandon_time = NULL, n.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, n.update_time = NOW() WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.task_id = #{taskId} AND n.node_type = 'review'

UPDATE label_data_entry e SET e.latest_node_id = ( SELECT MAX(n.id) FROM label_entry_node n WHERE n.entry_id = e.id AND n.deleted = 0 AND n.task_id = #{taskId} ), e.updated_by = #{userId}, e.update_time = NOW() WHERE e.id = #{entryId} AND e.deleted = 0

UPDATE label_data_entry e JOIN label_entry_node n ON n.entry_id = e.id SET e.latest_node_id = n.id, e.updated_by = #{userId}, e.update_time = NOW() WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.task_id = #{taskId} AND n.node_key = #{nodeKey} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.task_id = #{taskId} AND (e.latest_node_id IS NULL OR e.latest_node_id < n.id)
